# k8s_resource (Resource)

_Kubernetes_ resource managed with server-side apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "k8s_resource" "example" {
  manifest = {
    apiVersion = "v1"
    kind       = "ConfigMap"
    metadata = {
      name      = "example"
      namespace = "default"
    }
    data = {
      foo = "bar"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (Dynamic) Partial resource manifest describing the desired managed subset.

### Optional

- `field_manager` (Attributes) Field manager configuration for this resource, overriding provider defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--field_manager))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `managed_fields_fingerprint` (String) Computed fingerprint of the live object projected onto the managed manifest subset.

<a id="nestedatt--field_manager"></a>
### Nested Schema for `field_manager`

Optional:

- `force_conflicts` (Boolean) Whether to force conflicts during server-side apply.
- `name` (String) Field manager name.
